checks.choice: PASS: touch opens anchored menu, matching width, selection identity, dismiss preserves value, disabled and detached controls close menu, long options selectable.
checks.stepper: PASS: single-unit taps, accelerating hold, release/cancel/disable/detach stop, bounded values, manual editing and accessibility click; decimal temperature +/-1, comma, negative values, zero crossing and -55/125 bounds.
checks.scroll: PASS: attached dashboard preserves top/mid-page scroll during initial polling, late Save acknowledgement, history changes and disconnect/reconnect; explicit input focus, visible editing and draft/caret preserved.
checks.render: PASS: hero remains identical across 30 redraws at each of two sizes; center stays opaque.
checks.unlock: PASS: PIN/backup detection, freshness, old firmware, popup deduplication, masking, empty input, defer, physical unlock, permanent lock and background guard.

limitations: Offline UI fixtures; no physical device or live account commands in this release validation.
